Description: Skeleton, gateway, CI/CD, observability bootstrap, minimal LiteLLM, eval harness seed.

Description: Create src/eadip package layout (gateway, orchestrator, agents, retrieval, analytics, mcp, memory, domain, ports, adapters, security, eval, observability, config) plus tests/deploy/docs.
Acceptance Criteria: Repo builds; uv sync --frozen works; import graph respects ports-and-adapters; pre-commit (ruff+black) green.

Summary: API Gateway: POST /v1/runs accept + SSE skeleton
Description: FastAPI app exposing POST /v1/runs (202) and GET /v1/runs/{id}/events (SSE stub).
Acceptance Criteria: POST returns 202 with Run; SSE endpoint streams a heartbeat event; OpenAPI generated.

Description: Multi-stage Dockerfile with uv, minimal runtime base, non-root user, pinned digests.
Acceptance Criteria: Image builds under target size; runs as uid 10001; CMD serves gateway on 8000.

Description: Compose brings up gateway + Postgres + Redis + Qdrant + Neo4j for local dev.
Acceptance Criteria: docker compose up starts full stack; healthchecks pass.

Description: lint -> type-check -> test -> eval-gate(placeholder) -> SAST/scan -> build/sign -> deploy staging.
Acceptance Criteria: Failing lint/type/test blocks merge; signed image pushed; staging deploy succeeds.

Description: OTel SDK + collector; correlation id; JSON logs; per-request trace.
Acceptance Criteria: Every request emits a trace with a correlation id visible in the trace backend.

Description: Provider-agnostic model client via LiteLLM; config-driven; single-tier routing stub.
Acceptance Criteria: A test prompt routes through LiteLLM to a configured provider; tokens/cost recorded on the span.

Summary: Eval harness skeleton + gold-set v1 seed
Description: Harness scaffolding (grader interface) + seed gold dataset; wired as CI placeholder gate.
Acceptance Criteria: Harness runs on gold-set v1; CI eval-gate stage executes (non-blocking placeholder).

Description: Helm chart for gateway Deployment + Service + Ingress; staging values.
Acceptance Criteria: helm install deploys gateway to a namespace; readiness/liveness probes pass.

Description: Deny-by-default identity, tenancy, immutable audit before capability.
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-tenant access impossible; every authz decision + mutation audited; secrets only in vault.

Description: OIDC redirect/code exchange; map claims (sub, tenant, roles); short-lived service JWT; httpOnly session.
Acceptance Criteria: User logs in via IdP; session cookie httpOnly; downstream calls carry identity+tenant claim.

Description: Role -> Permission -> (resource, data-domain, effect); resolve effective set per request; deny-by-default.
Acceptance Criteria: User without a domain permission is denied + audited; permitted user proceeds.

Description: tenant_id on all tables; RLS policies bound to app.tenant_id session var.
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-tenant SELECT returns zero rows; verified by test with two tenants.

Description: Secrets in vault; mint short-lived user-scoped tokens per call; none in logs/prompts.
Acceptance Criteria: No secret appears in logs/config; tokens expire; rotation works.

Description: audit_event append-only (role+trigger); log authz decisions, queries, tool calls, approvals.
Acceptance Criteria: UPDATE/DELETE on audit_event denied; every authz decision + mutation produces an event (US-B2).

Description: Polyglot stores + governed, embedded, ACL-tagged chunks.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant corpus ingests with ACL + time payload; PII redacted in artifacts.

Description: Postgres+pgvector, Qdrant, Neo4j, Redis, object store provisioned; expand/contract migrations.
Acceptance Criteria: All stores reachable in CI; migrations apply/rollback cleanly.

Description: Parse, chunk, attach source/ACL/time payload.
Acceptance Criteria: A mixed doc set ingests; chunks carry acl_tags + valid_from/to.

Description: Generate+store dense+sparse vectors; version embed model; cache by content hash.
Acceptance Criteria: Embeddings stored in per-tenant collection; re-ingest of same content is a cache hit.

Description: Named vectors (dense+bm25); payload indexes for acl_tags + valid_from.
Acceptance Criteria: Collection created per tenant; filtered search by ACL/time works.

Description: Detect+redact PII in stored intermediate artifacts/logs by default.
Acceptance Criteria: Ingested doc with PII stores redacted; raw PII absent from artifacts.

Description: Identity-scoped, time-aware hybrid retrieval with reranking.
Acceptance Criteria: Grounded retrieval; filtered docs never influence ranking; latency in budget.

Summary: Dense + sparse hybrid search with RRF
Description: Dense ANN + BM25; fuse with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
Acceptance Criteria: Hybrid query returns fused ranked passages with source refs.

Description: Apply identity ACL + metadata + time filter before fusion.
Acceptance Criteria: Docs the user cannot see never appear or influence ranking; proven by test.

Description: Re-score top fused set; extractive+abstractive compression to token budget.
Acceptance Criteria: Top-k precision improves vs no-rerank on eval; compressed context within budget.

Description: Expand complex query into sub-queries; fuse results.
Acceptance Criteria: Complex query expands into N sub-queries; recall improves on eval set.

Description: valid_from/to filtering for point-in-time queries.
Acceptance Criteria: As-of query returns point-in-time truth; recency query returns latest.

Description: Safe NL-to-SQL over governed warehouses + explanatory statistics.
Acceptance Criteria: Verified metric-movement explanation; no non-read-only SQL executes; claims carry queries.

Description: Generate SQL from NL against governed schema (structured output).
Acceptance Criteria: NL request yields schema-valid SQL bound to its result.

Description: Reject non-SELECT, unknown columns, missing tenant predicate, over-cost; statement timeout + row cap; read replica.
Acceptance Criteria: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL rejected; missing tenant predicate rejected; over-cost aborted.

Description: Trend decomposition + contribution analysis across dimensions.
Acceptance Criteria: Metric movement explained with ranked signed drivers (US-A1).

Description: STL/robust z-score anomalies; correlation labeled candidate-only.
Acceptance Criteria: Anomalies flagged with severity; correlations not labeled causal.

Description: Statistical baseline forecast + prediction intervals.
Acceptance Criteria: Forecast returns point+interval, explicitly labeled uncertain.

Description: Interpret -> plan -> route -> execute -> reflect; durable, streamed, bounded.
Acceptance Criteria: Multi-step run re-plans, streams, resumes after restart, respects bounds.

Description: NL -> structured Objective (intent, entities, metrics, timeframe, ambiguities).
Acceptance Criteria: Objective extracted; high-ambiguity emits clarification not a guess.

Description: Decompose objective into ordered typed steps + parallel branches + stop condition.
Acceptance Criteria: Plan produced with deps; depth bounded; plan reuse seeded from memory.

Description: Show steps/sources/tools with proceed/edit/cancel.
Acceptance Criteria: Complex question shows plan; user can proceed/edit/cancel (US-A2).

Description: Typed RunState with reducers; nodes + conditional edges; Postgres checkpointer; resume.
Acceptance Criteria: Multi-step run executes; crash mid-run resumes from checkpoint.

Description: Retry+backoff with idempotency; iteration cap + loop detection; per-step+global timeout; per-run cost ceiling.
Acceptance Criteria: Runaway loop breaks at cap; cost ceiling aborts to partial answer; retries cause no duplicate side effects.

Description: Judge sufficiency; gaps -> re-plan, sufficient -> verify; bounded loop.
Acceptance Criteria: Insufficient evidence triggers re-plan; sufficient routes to verify.

Description: Publish step transitions/tool calls/partial findings to per-run Redis stream -> SSE.
Acceptance Criteria: First streamed token under 3s p95; user sees live steps (US-A3).

Description: Independent verification, confidence, provenance, executive brief. ALPHA gate.
Acceptance Criteria: Alpha: one investigation type end-to-end with independent verification + full audit; eval harness live.

Description: Fresh-context recompute/resource-lookup/cross-source; status verified/unverified/conflicting.
Acceptance Criteria: Each quantitative claim re-derived independently; conflicts marked, never silently reconciled.

Description: Attach calibrated confidence + assumptions per conclusion.
Acceptance Criteria: Each conclusion carries a calibrated score + assumptions (US-B3).

Description: Link each number to query/doc + verification status.
Acceptance Criteria: Every quantitative claim exposes source + verified/unverified/conflicting (US-B1).

Description: Rank actions by impact x confidence from verified claims only.
Acceptance Criteria: Ranked explainable actions; unverified material caveated, never silently promoted.

Description: Layered output headline -> drivers -> evidence -> raw; multi-format export.
Acceptance Criteria: One-page brief renders with drill-down + export (US-E1/E2).

Description: Persist run state to short/long-term memory.
Acceptance Criteria: Run conversation+plan+findings persisted and retrievable.

Description: Onboard any system as a governed tool, declaratively, no code deploy.
Acceptance Criteria: New MCP server registered via portal is discovered, health-checked, invocable under RBAC.

Description: Register endpoint+auth+declarative permission scope in portal.
Acceptance Criteria: Server registered without deploy; appears pending discovery (US-D1).

Description: List tools, cache JSON schemas; health states + circuit breaker + backoff.
Acceptance Criteria: Tools discovered + schemas cached; failed server enters Failed -> retry.

Description: Effect+domains+ACL descriptor; RBAC checked pre-invoke deny-by-default.
Acceptance Criteria: Unauthorized tool call denied+audited; user-scoped token minted on permit.

Description: Match step -> tool by capability/schema; validate args vs JSON schema; treat output as data.
Acceptance Criteria: Args validated pre-call; tool output never executed as instructions.

Description: Alternate tool/path when degraded/failed; continue with narrowed scope.
Acceptance Criteria: Failed tool falls back; run continues and states the limitation.

Description: No write/high-impact action without explicit human approval.
Acceptance Criteria: Side-effecting step pauses for approval; safety suite shows zero unapproved actions.

Description: interrupt_before on write/high-impact; checkpoint persisted on pause.
Acceptance Criteria: Write step pauses graph and persists checkpoint (US-C1).

Description: Show proposed action + exact payload; approve -> execute user-scoped; reject -> skip+record.
Acceptance Criteria: Approver sees payload; approve executes; reject logged+skipped.

Description: Configure autonomy per action type; read auto, write gated.
Acceptance Criteria: Policy makes reads auto and writes gated; configurable per type (US-C2).

Description: Grounding suppression, fail-safe partial, human override; injection + unapproved-action red-team.
Acceptance Criteria: Safety suite shows 0 unapproved-action attempts passing; ungrounded claims suppressed/flagged.

Description: Answer structural why-questions via metric lineage. PRIVATE BETA gate.
Acceptance Criteria: Beta: driver analysis via lineage works; >=90% accuracy on partner gold set; RBAC+audit+approval in use.

Description: Metric/Dimension/DataSource/Entity/Event/Doc/Team + uniqueness constraints.
Acceptance Criteria: Schema+constraints applied; nodes uniquely keyed.

Description: Extract entities/relations; ingest metric lineage with driver weights+direction.
Acceptance Criteria: Lineage graph populated; DRIVER_OF weights queryable.

Description: Cypher bounded traversal; extract relevant subgraph.
Acceptance Criteria: Driver/event queries return a bounded subgraph within depth limit.

Description: Linearize subgraph to evidence; merge with vector hits; wire to Planner effort.
Acceptance Criteria: Root-cause question answered via lineage + vector evidence, verified.

Description: Memory, prompt mgmt, model routing, notifications, admin portal, platform services.
Acceptance Criteria: Admins self-serve RBAC/prompts/routing/budgets; memory improves repeats; cost capped; UI WCAG 2.1 AA.

Description: Working/episodic/semantic; Memory Agent consolidation; no PII to shared semantic; erasure cascade.
Acceptance Criteria: Repeat question reuses prior plan; PII not promoted; DSAR erasure cascades to memory.

Description: Immutable versions; eval-gated promotion; canary; one-click rollback.
Acceptance Criteria: Bad prompt rolled back in one click; runs record exact version used (US-D2).

Description: Per-task tiering; verify/plan pinned strong; budget-aware fallback.
Acceptance Criteria: Verification never downgraded; budget guard + provider fallback work.

Description: Notify completion/approval/anomaly via channels.
Acceptance Criteria: User notified on completion and approval-required via configured channel.

Description: Manage tenants/users/roles/connectors/budgets/flags + prompt/model governance.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin self-serves RBAC, connectors, budgets, flags (US-D3).

Description: Caching layers; KEDA queue partitioning; token-bucket rate limit; admission control.
Acceptance Criteria: Queues isolated by class; 429s actionable; cheapest work shed under load.

Description: Keyboard, screen-reader semantics, contrast, reduced-motion, accessible tables.
Acceptance Criteria: Automated a11y checks pass in CI; manual audit clears AA.

Description: Scale, reliability, DR, residency, eval gates, security, compliance. GA gate.
Acceptance Criteria: GA: all Must met; SLOs sustained 30 days; security review + per-vertical compliance sign-off.

Description: Load test cluster to target concurrency; validate HPA/KEDA.
Acceptance Criteria: 200 concurrent investigations sustained without SLO breach.

Description: Inject failures; verify breakers, idempotency, degradation, resume.
Acceptance Criteria: Faults degrade gracefully; no duplicate side effects; runs resume.

Description: WAL+snapshots; cross-AZ/region replication; IaC restore; game-day.
Acceptance Criteria: RPO <=5min, RTO <=1hr proven in a DR drill.

Description: Per-tenant region; retention policies; secure deletion; DSAR.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant data stays in-region; erasure removes from stores+memory+logs.

Summary: Full eval suite as hard CI gates
Description: Accuracy >=92%, verified >=95%, grounding, safety, no unapproved actions - hard gates.
Acceptance Criteria: Build below threshold cannot promote; gates enforced not advisory.

Description: Scanning in CI; external penetration test before GA.
Acceptance Criteria: Pen-test findings remediated; scans green; images signed+pinned.

Description: SOC2/GDPR/HIPAA/SOX/ISO27001/EU AI Act evidence as applicable.
Acceptance Criteria: Per-vertical legal sign-off complete; audit evidence assembled (GA gate).

Description: Continuous security track woven through every sprint.
Acceptance Criteria: New boundaries threat-modeled; injection evals maintained each phase.

Summary: Recurring: threat-model new boundaries each phase
Description: Each phase: threat-model + injection review of new surfaces.
Acceptance Criteria: New boundaries have a threat note; injection evals added before phase exit.

Description: Continuous evaluation track; gold sets grow per phase.
Acceptance Criteria: Each capability has eval coverage before its phase exits.

Summary: Recurring: grow gold sets + graders per phase
Description: Add gold cases + graders for each new capability.
Acceptance Criteria: New capability has eval coverage before phase exit.

Description: Continuous observability/cost track.
Acceptance Criteria: New hot-path calls emit spans with cost+tokens.

Summary: Recurring: spans + cost accounting on new hot-path calls
Description: Instrument new model/tool/store calls.
Acceptance Criteria: New hot-path call emits a span with cost+tokens.

Description: Continuous refactor capacity to keep clean architecture.
Acceptance Criteria: No framework leakage into domain; debt triaged each retro.

Summary: Recurring: refactor to keep clean architecture
Description: Reserve capacity; keep ports-and-adapters clean.
Acceptance Criteria: No framework leakage into domain; debt log triaged each retro.
